backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the freelance platform backend with user profiles, jobs, and proposals; includes role-based access control, blob storage mixins, and CRUD operations for customers and freelancers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that RoleSelectionPage was fixed to not pre-populate or lock in a previously chosen role, with high confidence tied to test REQ-6.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key behavior of every page, component, hook, and config file in the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, primary, secondary, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app into a root div and loading the TypeScript entry point via a module script tag.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (login, role-selection, dashboards, job details, proposals, profiles) and wraps the app with ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/JobCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a job's title, description, budget, category, open/closed status badge, optional proposal count, and an optional action slot.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell component providing a sticky header with logo, role-aware navigation buttons, a user avatar dropdown (dashboard, profile, logout), and a main content area for child routes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor using React Query, reinitializing access control and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, jobs, and proposals, wrapping actor calls with useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Sora fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm neutral color palette with amber/teal accents in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreateJobPage.tsx: Page component for customers to post a new job, with a form for title, description, budget, and category, guarded by authentication and customer role checks.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for customers showing stats and a list of their posted jobs, with navigation guards ensuring only authenticated customers can access it.
frontend/src/pages/FreelancerDashboard.t: Dashboard page for freelancers displaying open jobs with search/category filtering and a proposals tab, restricted to authenticated users with the freelancer role.
frontend/src/pages/FreelancerProfilePage: Displays a public freelancer profile page fetched by userId, showing name, hourly rate, bio, skills, and a resume download button, with loading skeleton and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/JobDetailsPage.tsx: Shows details of a specific job and lists submitted proposals with a ProposalCard component that allows the job owner to view freelancer profiles and accept proposals.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Landing/login page that authenticates users via Internet Identity and redirects them to the appropriate dashboard or role-selection page based on their profile.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx: Form page for freelancers to edit their profile (display name, bio, skills, hourly rate, resume upload), pre-populated with existing data and guarded against non-freelancer roles.
frontend/src/pages/RoleSelectionPage.tsx: Onboarding page where newly authenticated users choose between customer and freelancer roles, then get redirected to the corresponding dashboard after role creation.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitProposalPage.ts: A React page that allows authenticated freelancers to submit a proposal (cover letter and proposed price) for a specific job, with guards redirecting non-freelancers or unauthenticated users and handling duplicate application detection.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting, retrieving, and clearing parameters via sessionStorage and the browser history API.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, keyframe animations, and plugins (typography, container-queries, animate) for the frontend design system.
project_state.json: A JSON file tracking the project's current state, including version, feature list, architectural notes, and known issues for a two-role (customer/freelancer) freelancing marketplace app.
